title: Relic of the Void
synopsis: An experimental test pilot loses control near a rotating black hole, slingshotting around the event horizon under extreme gravitational time dilation. When he emerges, 1,000 years have passed. Salvaged by a fierce space pirate captain, he must navigate vacuum warfare, pirate politics, and his growing feelings for his captor while discovering humanity's ancestral home is gone.

chapters.title: The Ergosphere Slingshot
chapters.summary: Leo Mercer conducts an experimental torch burn near Cygnus X-1; antimatter injector failure pulls him into the gravitational well; crushing g-forces as he skims the ergosphere; time dilation accelerates; waking up to silent, dead systems 1,000 years in the future as a pirate boarding team cuts through his airlock.

chapters.title: Boarding Action
chapters.summary: Captain Astrid 'Vex' Ross breaches the cockpit expecting scrap, finding a living Golden Age pilot; standoff in zero gravity; razor-sharp banter and initial sparks of tension as she disarms him and brings him aboard the Starlight Marauder.

chapters.title: A Thousand Years from Home
chapters.summary: Leo is confined to the medical bay; Orlo inspects his flight suit and prototype telemetry; Astrid interrogates him; Leo learns the devastating truth that 1,000 years have passed and Earth is an ancient ruin.

chapters.title: The Scavenger's Code
chapters.summary: A rival corsair wolf-pack ambushes the Starlight Marauder; Astrid's flight pilot is incapacitated by shrapnel; Leo takes the flight couch and executes a manual high-g drift maneuver that saves the ship.

chapters.title: G-Force and Starlight
chapters.summary: Aftermath of the dogfight; Astrid treats Leo's acceleration bruising in private quarters; mutual respect turns into intense, breathless physical proximity; establishing a fragile partnership.

chapters.title: The Corsair Haven of Ostra-9
chapters.summary: Docking at a hollowed-out asteroid pirate station; decadent space bazaars, lawless bounty hunters, and orbital speakeasies; Leo sees the wild, fractured 31st-century human frontier.

chapters.title: Bounty on the Ghost
chapters.summary: Word spreads that Astrid has recovered a Golden Age military prototype; pirate syndicates and Dominion informants close in; a neon-lit shootout through the pressurized market tunnels.

chapters.title: The Thermal Shadow
chapters.summary: Escaping Ostra-9 into the shadow of a gas giant's ring system; running dark with radiators stowed; silent, freezing tension inside the cockpit; shared whispers and vulnerable admissions in the dark.

chapters.title: The Derelict Dyson Array
chapters.summary: Investigating a colossal shattered star-collector orbiting a red dwarf; breathtaking cosmic scale; searching for antimatter fuel canisters to recharge the Chronos-1.

chapters.title: Zero-G Entanglement
chapters.summary: Tethered spacewalk inside the hollow megastructure; micro-meteorite rupture forces Leo and Astrid into an emergency pressure shelter; heated intimacy and their first passionate kiss floating in weightlessness.

chapters.title: The Dominion Patrol
chapters.summary: A Dominion heavy cruiser ambushes them at the edge of the array; long-range kinetic railgun duel across 5,000 kilometers; physics-grounded missile interception.

chapters.title: The Deceleration Burn
chapters.summary: Surviving a crushing 6-g flip-and-burn burn into an asteroid trench; physical toll on the human body; Astrid and Leo's bond tested and deepened under pressure.

chapters.title: Secrets of the Chronos Core
chapters.summary: Orlo unlocks an encrypted black-box partition on Leo's flight recorder; coordinates to an ancient automated orbital shipyard hidden in a cometary cloud.

chapters.title: The Pirate King's Summons
chapters.summary: The Corsair Syndicate council demands Astrid hand over Leo and the ship; Astrid defies the syndicate lords, choosing loyalty to Leo over her pirate standing.

chapters.title: A Kiss Before the Jump
chapters.summary: The eve of battle; spending the night together in the captain's quarters; passionate, high-heat romantic commitment before entering hostile territory.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Oort Cloud
chapters.summary: Arriving at the cometary coordinates only to find an ambush; Syndicate traitors have sold them out to the Dominion navy; heavy damage to the Marauder.

chapters.title: Flight of the Ancient Torch
chapters.summary: Leo launches the repaired Chronos-1 prototype; flying manual maneuvers impossible for modern computerized ships; cutting through the enemy fighter screen.

chapters.title: The Silent Broadside
chapters.summary: Tactical coordination between the Marauder and Chronos-1; disabling the Dominion cruiser's thermal radiators, forcing them to surrender or cook from waste heat.

chapters.title: Awakening the Shipyard
chapters.summary: Docking at the ancient Golden Age automated shipyard; the station's AI recognizes Leo's biometric clearance as Commander; lights flicker on across a fleet of sleeping ships.

chapters.title: Horizon's Edge
chapters.summary: The Starlight Marauder is upgraded with Golden Age drives; Astrid and Leo stand side-by-side on the command deck as partners and lovers; charting a course for the lost cradle of Sol.
